summary: US stocks ended the week higher after Friday's small dip: the S&P 500 closed at 7,561.67 (+2.5% on the week, -0.4% on the day) and the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.9% on Friday but gained 2.3% over five sessions, while the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 5.15%. Brent held near $95.84 and WTI near $88.56 (both about 2.5% lower on the week), US natural gas rose 7.7% on the week and TTF gas in Europe 6.3%. Gold fell 4.6% and silver 5.4% over the week and copper 2.4%, while Corteva dropped 20.8% on the week after a 24% fall on 12 November, and Paladin Energy (ASX) fell 17.6% in a day. Cheniere gained 11.1% on the week; VIX closed at 19.3, down 25% on the week. Several freight, cobalt, urea, NdPr and JKM readings could not be dated to Friday and are listed under gaps.

overlap.reason: EU-China trade policy touches European equities.

reading.title: Trump promises an oil bonanza in Venezuela, but critics question who will benefit
reading.summary: Acting Venezuelan leader says the US deal will bring about USD 200 billion; critics say Venezuela may forgo large sums and environmental costs are unaddressed.

overlap.reason: Venezuelan oil supply read-through for crude.

reading.title: Q&A with Ana Toni: We need to plan how to get out of fossil fuels
reading.summary: The former COP30 chief executive says the new roadmap helps countries gauge fossil fuel dependence and choose fitting policies.

reading.title: Nova Scotia Bets on Microelectronics Integration, Not Chip Fabs
reading.summary: Says Nova Scotia is unlikely to become a wafer-fab destination and is instead pursuing microelectronics integration and advanced packaging. Feed text truncated.

reading.title: NewSpace-Grade NOR Flash: Right-Sized Reliability for Space Missions
reading.summary: Infineon-authored white paper on how total ionizing dose and single-event effects degrade NOR flash in space. Vendor-contributed.

reading.title: electronica 2026: Chipmakers Move Up the Stack as Data Centers and Physical AI Take Center Stage
reading.summary: Show report on chipmakers taking a system- and platform-level approach, with emphasis on data centers, physical AI, MCUs and power management.

reading.title: Utility, tech officials see opportunities to increase grid utilization
reading.summary: Panelists at a BNEF summit said AI models and grid-enhancing technologies could help, though basic planning tools already exist to make the grid more flexible.

reading.title: What's next for California's climate laws following an appeals court split decision
reading.summary: The Ninth Circuit let Scope 1 and 2 emissions reporting under SB 253 proceed while halting enforcement of Scope 3 reporting and SB 261.

reading.title: Southern Co. eyes $100B spending plan on natural gas, nuclear and other investments
reading.summary: Southern Co. executives discussed a roughly $100 billion spending plan on its third-quarter call and said political change should not sweep away its strategy.

reading.title: Freeport strikes $77M deal for BC copper stake
reading.summary: Freeport-McMoRan agreed to buy 51% of TDG Gold's Aurora West project in British Columbia, with options to raise its stake via exploration funding and a further payment.

overlap.reason: Freeport is the acquirer.

reading.title: Capstone cuts copper outlook as restart slips
reading.summary: Capstone Copper lowered the low end of its production forecast by 5,000 tonnes after delaying the Pinto Valley restart to mid-December; a Chilean national strike adds supply risk.

overlap.reason: Copper supply disruption read-through.

reading.title: Modern Mining makes NYSE American debut
reading.summary: Modern Mining, which recovers metals from electronic waste, listed on NYSE American after an IPO of about $40 million and closed its first day down 3.5%.

reading.title: 'Miracle on the Mississippi': All Accounted For After Tanker Capsizes Cruise Ship in New Orleans
reading.summary: All passengers and crew of an American Cruise Lines riverboat survived after a tanker struck it in New Orleans; the feed excerpt is cut off.

reading.title: Tanker Strikes Docked Paddlewheeler on Mississippi River, Causing It to Capsize
reading.summary: A Marshall Islands-flagged asphalt tanker struck the docked American Cruise Lines riverboat on the Mississippi, which capsized; the feed excerpt is cut off.

reading.title: Gulf Oil Exports Recover as Hormuz Shipping Struggles
reading.summary: Oil markets are recovering from the Iran war, but Strait of Hormuz traffic remains far below pre-conflict levels, per the feed excerpt citing the IEA.

overlap.reason: Gulf export flows bear on crude supply.
Tanker traffic through Hormuz is disrupted.

reading.title: Industry urges nuclear recognition in COP31's 35-by-35 pledge
reading.summary: Industry leaders want the COP31 pledge on electricity reaching 35% of final energy by 2035 to name nuclear; 88 GWe is under construction and 39 countries back tripling nuclear.

overlap.reason: Nuclear policy backdrop for uranium equities.

reading.title: Russia proposes carbon credits framework for SMRs
reading.summary: Rosatom submitted a draft methodology to the UN climate secretariat to let small modular reactors up to 300 MW earn Paris Agreement carbon credits.

reading.title: Estonia narrows search for nuclear power plant location
reading.summary: Estonia's first-plant site search now focuses on three locations in Viru-Nigula municipality, with a decision expected by end of 2027.

reading.title: Nepal's climate suffering should pave the way for a safe and fair future
reading.summary: Nepal's environment minister writes that young people seek international solidarity at COP31 and describes the August Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi disaster.

reading.title: COP31 Bulletin Day 5: Cover decision wishlist issued as China bows out of COP33 hosting
reading.summary: Covers the presidencies' summary of views on a possible COP31 cover decision, China reportedly ruling out hosting COP33, and Friday's finance and trade talks.

reading.title: We must strengthen trade cooperation to deliver on global climate goals
reading.summary: A comment by the Coalition of Trade Ministers on Climate argues cooperation is needed to reduce fragmentation as governments use trade measures for climate targets.

reading.title: South African court dismisses appeal over planned coal-fired power plants
reading.summary: South Africa's Supreme Court of Appeal rejected the government's appeal against a ruling blocking 1,500 MW of new coal power, brought by environmental groups.

reading.title: Honduras declares 'environmental emergency' in Río Plátano Biosphere Reserve
reading.summary: A presidential decree declares a 36-month emergency in Honduras's largest protected area, with about $55 million to curb deforestation, crime and ranching.

reading.title: Bigger and more-frequent wildfires threaten water supplies across the US
reading.summary: Record US wildfire acreage affects drinking water as ash washes into streams and can force intake shutoffs; studies suggest contamination may last up to 15 years.

reading.title: Nova Scotia Bets on Microelectronics Integration, Not Chip Fabs
reading.summary: Argues Nova Scotia is unlikely to host wafer fabs and that its microelectronics opportunity lies in assembling the right mix of capabilities.

reading.title: NewSpace-Grade NOR Flash: Right-Sized Reliability for Space Missions
reading.summary: White paper noting radiation effects degrade NOR Flash, with charge pumps, sense amplifiers and control logic often failing before the storage array.

reading.summary: Show report: chipmakers emphasised system- and platform-level approaches, with hardware-software work for physical and edge AI.

climate.headline: El Niño Advisory in force; strong-to-very-strong event likely through Jan-Mar 2027
climate.detail: CPC gives 83% odds of a historic event (3-month RONI of +2.5C or more) for Oct-Dec; Niño-3.4 was +2.1C. Bolivia has declared a national drought emergency.
climate.source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center, ENSO discussion, 8 Oct 2026; UN News, 9 Nov 2026

climate.headline: EU gas storage 75% full on 31 October, lowest for the time of year since 2013
climate.detail: IEA says end-March storage could be 33% in a favourable case and 7% in the worst case; Germany reached 61% by 2 November.
climate.source: International Energy Agency, Global Gas Security Review, reported 3 Nov 2026

climate.headline: Rhine gauge at Kaub falls to about 19-21 cm
climate.detail: Reading is far below the 77 cm low-water reference and down from above 50 cm days earlier; cruise operators cancelled some Middle Rhine departures.
climate.source: German waterway gauge data as reported by Rus Tourism News, 2 Nov 2026

climate.headline: COP31 opens with finance split; African Group's adaptation-finance item left off agenda
climate.detail: Adaptation finance will be handled across several negotiation strands; the Arab Group opposed references to COP30 fossil-fuel and deforestation roadmaps. No Article 6 outcome was found.
climate.source: UNFCCC process as reported by Climate Home News, 9 Nov 2026, and The Rio Times, 14 Nov 2026

climate.headline: IMD warns of weak northeast monsoon and 77% of normal November rain
climate.detail: IMD expects above-normal temperatures; southern peninsular India is also forecast at 77% of its November average.
climate.source: India Meteorological Department outlook, reported 31 Oct 2026

climate.headline: PAGASA does not rule out another typhoon in 2026 as Asian rice hits two-year high
climate.detail: PAGASA has logged 19 cyclones in its area this year. Thai 5% broken rice reached $499 a ton on 4 Nov, highest since December 2024, with El Niño dryness cited.
climate.source: PAGASA, 10 Nov 2026; Thai Rice Exporters Association via The Edge Malaysia, 5 Nov 2026
